# SPECTER SDR

SPECTER SDR is a local-first multi-receiver signal intelligence workstation for Windows. It coordinates one to eight supported local or remote receiver sources for parallel scanning, four-view 2D and 3D analysis, live decoding, synchronized recording, and evidence review.

Core capabilities:
- Fourteen guided Decoder Lab profiles
- Five built-in frame or checksum validating profiles for Mode-S and ADS-B, APRS, POCSAG, and NOAA SAME
- Wireless sensor decoding on 315, 433, 868, and 915 MHz through rtl_433
- Radiosonde telemetry through auto_rx
- AIS through AIS-catcher, ACARS through acarsdec, NOAA APT through SatDump, and digital voice events through DSD-FME
- One to six simultaneous Advanced Display visualizers
- One to eight coordinated receiver sources, full-array scanning, Frequency Manager, CTCSS, and synchronized session review
- SigMF IQ capture and playback, remote rtl_tcp receivers, ADS-B mapping, SBS output, Icecast streaming, and rigctl control

Receiver status:
- Validated paths include RTL2832U receivers, bladeRF 1.x and 2.0 micro, and remote rtl_tcp sources.
- LimeSDR Original and Mini integration is included, but current Windows physical hardware validation remains in progress.

## September 24, 2026 help refresh

The help center is reviewed against source v1.7.41 (b577b42). The latest public release is v1.7.41, published September 24, 2026. Version-specific instructions distinguish its behavior from earlier installed releases.

- [What's New and version availability](https://specter-sdr.com/help/whats-new): Version boundaries for 1.7.39, 1.7.40, and 1.7.41.
- [Channel Activity Watch](https://specter-sdr.com/help/channel-activity): RF-background-based detection on a tuned receiver, response settings, pre-roll WAV recording, and limitations.
- [Radiation counter and timeline](https://specter-sdr.com/help/radiation): GQ GMC serial instruments, background-based excursions, display placement, and session telemetry.
- [Receiver identity](https://specter-sdr.com/help/receiver-setup#unique-serial): New receiver naming and verified unique serials for supported factory-serial local RTL dongles.
- [Audible alerts](https://specter-sdr.com/help/recording-alerts#audible-alerts): Separate aircraft and RF-class tones, defaults, and output routing.

The SDR demo is 30 elapsed minutes from first launch, not ten minutes and not accumulated active time. TinySA sweep-point choices are 101, 145, 290, and 450 subject to the device ceiling. Advanced Display supports one to six tiles. Channel activity is not a packet decode or speech recognition.
